name: sim_variational_quantum_bridge_pytorch
purpose: Bridge classical SGD optimization (PyTorch) with quantum constraint structure (z3); validate entanglement-maximization convergence.

pytorch.reason: Autograd differentiation for gate parameters; SGD optimizer for variational circuit training toward entanglement maximization.

z3.reason: Symbolic verification that parameter update directions maintain unitary structure; UNSAT rules out non-admissible gradient steps.

numpy.reason: Pauli matrix definitions; statevector evolution for ground-truth comparison; entanglement measure baseline.

scipy.reason: Matrix exponential for parameterized gates; eigensolver for concurrence calculation.

sympy.reason: Symbolic differentiation of gate parameters; not required when PyTorch autograd suffices.

TopoNetX.reason: Circuit topology as hypergraph; not required for single 2-qubit circuit.

PyGeometric.reason: Message passing for parameter space structure; not required for dense optimization.

Clifford.reason: Clifford algebra for gate representations; not required; matrix representation sufficient.

cvc5.reason: Alternative SMT solver; z3 sufficient for constraint validation.

qiskit.reason: Alternative circuit backend; not required; explicit matrix computation sufficient.

numba.reason: JIT for tight loops; PyTorch CUDA backend sufficient for 2-qubit system.

jax.reason: Alternative JAX framework; PyTorch sufficient for this problem.

z3_validation.interpretation: Parameter gradients admissible for unitary evolution
